none: PAS NLM-1ED386: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Ethelred II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Penny of Aethelred II (978-1016), Canterbury mint issue of Leofstan, 1003-1009, as kindly identified by the finder, in excellent condition. The find spot, in the vicinity of a Viking encampment, is possibly significant, given the fresh condition of coin when lost. Obverse description: Helmeted cuirassed and shielded bust left. Initial cross potent. Obverse inscription: +EDELRED REX…
